solidworks_simulation_apply_radiation.doc: Apply a radiation load to the selected faces of a thermal simulation study. Creates one load in the study and does not save the document; the ok flag comes from the load count rising by exactly one rather than from the return value, and a static study leaves the count unchanged, so create a thermal study first.

params.study_name: Name of an existing simulation study; empty means the first study in the document. Defaults to empty.
params.selection: Declarative face selection the load applies to: '__current_selection__' for the current selection or 'index:<n>' for the n-th face on the body.
params.radiation_type: Radiation kind as an integer enum passed through to the official call; defaults to 0.

solidworks_simulation_apply_elastic_conn.doc: Add an elastic connector between the selected faces of a static simulation study. Creates one load in the study and does not save the document; the ok flag comes from the load count rising by exactly one rather than from the return value, and unlike the thermal loads this one takes a static study and not a thermal one.

params.study_name: Name of an existing simulation study; empty means the first study in the document. Defaults to empty.
params.selection: Declarative face selection the load applies to: '__current_selection__' for the current selection or 'index:<n>' for the n-th face on the body.

solidworks_simulation_apply_temperature.doc: Apply a temperature load to the selected faces of a thermal simulation study. Creates one load in the study and does not save the document; the ok flag comes from the load count rising by exactly one rather than from the return value, and a static study leaves the count unchanged, so create a thermal study first.

params.study_name: Name of an existing simulation study; empty means the first study in the document. Defaults to empty.
params.selection: Declarative face selection the load applies to: '__current_selection__' for the current selection or 'index:<n>' for the n-th face on the body.

solidworks_simulation_configure_static_s.doc: Set static solver options on the simulation study and report what was applied. Modifies the study options and does not save the document; an option left unset is not applied at all, so the study keeps whatever value it already had.

params.family: Study-options family name to write into; discover the valid names with solidworks_simulation_list_setter_summary. Defaults to ICWStaticStudyOptions.
params.free_body_force: Whether to use the free-body-force approach; omitted leaves it unchanged. Defaults to unset.
params.contact_penalty: Contact penalty stiffness; omitted leaves it unchanged. Defaults to unset.
params.reference_pressure: Reference pressure; omitted leaves it unchanged. Defaults to unset.

solidworks_simulation_configure_frequenc.doc: Set frequency solver options on the simulation study and report what was applied. Modifies the study options and does not save the document; an option left unset is not applied at all, so the study keeps whatever value it already had.

params.family: Study-options family name to write into; discover the valid names with solidworks_simulation_list_setter_summary. Defaults to ICWFrequencyStudyOptions.
params.decouple: Whether the frequency solve is decoupled; omitted leaves it unchanged. Defaults to unset.
params.reference_pressure: Reference pressure; omitted leaves it unchanged. Defaults to unset.

solidworks_simulation_configure_buckling.doc: Set buckling solver options on the simulation study and report what was applied. Modifies the study options and does not save the document; an option left unset is not applied at all, so the study keeps whatever value it already had.

params.family: Study-options family name to write into; discover the valid names with solidworks_simulation_list_setter_summary. Defaults to ICWBucklingStudyOptions.
params.modes: Number of buckling modes to extract; omitted leaves it unchanged. Defaults to unset.
params.positive_only: Whether only positive eigenvalues are kept; omitted leaves it unchanged. Defaults to unset.

solidworks_simulation_set_study_option.doc: Set one registered simulation study option by family and name and return a report of the result. Modifies the study options; the value is text that the registry converts to the declared type, and an unknown family or name comes back as a failed report with an error field instead of being silently skipped.

params.family: Study-options family name; discover the valid families and names with solidworks_simulation_list_setter_summary.
params.name: Setter name, which must exist in the registry for that family.
params.value: New value as text; the registry decides the type it is converted to.

solidworks_simulation_set_study_options.doc: Set several registered simulation study options at once and return the read-back values. Modifies the study options; every name must be registered for the family, and an unknown family or name comes back as a failed report with an error field instead of being silently skipped.

params.family: Study-options family name; discover the valid families and names with solidworks_simulation_list_setter_summary.
params.values: Mapping of setter name to value, each value as text; every name must be registered for the family.

solidworks_part_bounding_box.doc: Get the bounding box of one solid body in millimetres. Read-only; the values are approximate and SolidWorks states they must not be used for comparison or calculation, and the box can change after a rebuild, so treat it as a rough overview only.

params.body_index: Zero-based index of the solid body; defaults to 0.
params.include_hidden: Whether hidden bodies are included; defaults to false.

solidworks_hole_standards.doc: List the Hole Wizard standards available for one hole type, as id and name pairs. Read-only; the two output lists are paired by position, and hole type 5, the legacy type, officially returns nothing.

params.hole_type_id: Hole type from the general hole type enum; 5 is the legacy type and yields no data. Defaults to 0.

solidworks_fastener_types.doc: List the fastener types available under one Hole Wizard standard, as id and name pairs. Read-only; the names follow the SolidWorks interface language, so a Chinese interface returns Chinese names, and an id from this list is the fastener id the table-type tool expects.

params.standard_name: Standard name taken from solidworks_hole_standards, for example ANSI Inch. Defaults to empty.
params.hole_type_id: Hole type from the general hole type enum; 5 is the legacy type and yields no data. Defaults to 0.

solidworks_fastener_table_types.doc: List the fastener table type ids for one fastener under a Hole Wizard standard. Read-only; the second argument must be a fastener id from solidworks_fastener_types and not a size name, because a size name raises a type-mismatch error.

params.standard_name: Standard name taken from solidworks_hole_standards. Defaults to empty.
params.fastener_id: Fastener id from solidworks_fastener_types, as a number and not a size name; defaults to 0.
params.hole_type_id: Hole type from the general hole type enum. Defaults to 0.

solidworks_feature_cosmetic_thread.doc: Insert a cosmetic thread on a cylindrical face, finding that face and its edge without a preselection. Creates a cosmetic-thread feature and does not save the document; the diameter is given in millimetres, the end type is 0 for a blind thread that uses the depth or 2 for a through thread, and the end-to-end read through this tool has not been run yet.

params.standard: Thread standard as an integer; 1 is ANSI Metric.
params.standard_type: Standard subdivision string handed to the official call; the reference example passes an empty string.
params.size: Size string handed to the official call; the reference example passes an empty string.
params.diameter_mm: Nominal diameter in millimetres, converted once to the units the official call takes.
params.end_type: End condition: 0 = blind, where depth_mm applies, or 2 = through.
params.depth_mm: Thread depth in millimetres, used only for a blind end.
params.note: Note text stored with the thread; the reference example passes an empty string.

solidworks_sketch_spline.doc: Draw a spline through the given points in the active 2D sketch, creating a new sketch when none is active. Creates sketch geometry in millimetres from the sketch origin; it raises when the call produces nothing instead of reporting a silent success, and an end-to-end read of the result through this tool has not been run yet.

params.points: Control points as a list of [x, y] pairs in millimetres; at least two are required.

solidworks_flatten_surface.doc: Flatten a surface body into a flat surface feature, selecting the face and its anchor itself. Creates a flatten-surface feature and does not save the document; the accuracy factor runs from 1 to 10 with 1 the most accurate, an anchor that cannot be selected is reported as a failed precondition, and the end-to-end read through this tool has not been run yet.

params.accuracy_factor: Accuracy factor from 1 to 10, where 1 is the most accurate; the measured run used 4.
params.should_use_tears: Whether the flattening may tear the surface, passed through unchanged.
params.body_type: Which body list supplies the face: surface takes the surface bodies, solid takes the solid bodies. The default is surface.

solidworks_thicken.doc: Create a solid from a surface by thickening it, marking the reference face itself. Creates a thicken feature and does not save the document; a fill-volume thicken ignores every other argument and needs a closed surface, a cut with use_auto_select off needs the target bodies selected first, and the tool is not verified on a real machine yet.

params.thickness_mm: Thickness in millimetres, converted once to the metres the official call takes.
params.cut: True makes a thicken cut, false makes a thicken boss.
params.direction: Direction flag handed to the official call as an integer.
params.fill_volume: True fills the volume and ignores every other argument, which requires a closed surface.
params.merge: Whether the result merges into the existing body; this argument exists only on the boss form.
params.use_feat_scope: Feature-scope flag handed to the official call, which limits the feature to its own scope body list.
params.use_auto_select: For a cut, false means the target bodies must be selected before the call.
